title: EdgeFLAlert
description: Authenticated intrusion detection alert sent from Edge FL-IDS (Edge A/B/IoMT) to Server 1 ZTA Policy Engine.

alert_id.description: Unique identifier for tracing this alert through ZTA PE, SDN PEP, and Wazuh SIEM.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when Edge AI detected the anomaly (used as t1 in IPS response-time benchmark).

edge_id.description: Identifier of the Edge FL-IDS node generating the alert.

switch_dpid.description: 16-hex-char OpenFlow Datapath ID of the OVS PEP monitoring this segment.

src_mac.description: Source MAC address of the suspected attacker or compromised endpoint.

src_ip.description: Source IPv4 address observed in the mirrored flow.

dst_ip.description: Destination IPv4 address targeted by the flow.

attack_type.description: Predicted attack class from Edge-IIoTset / TON_IoT taxonomy (e.g., DDoS_TCP_Flood, Port_Scan, MITM).

confidence.description: Model softmax probability for the predicted attack class.

model_round.description: Current Flower Global Model round loaded on this Edge node.

features_summary.description: Optional summary of key flow features (packet_rate, byte_count, duration_ms) for SIEM/audit logging.
